randomization.method: python random.Random(seed).shuffle over per-task condition order

target_project.why_suitable: real user-maintained monorepo component; 37 hermetic pytest tests that run in <1s; poetry-pinned deps; no network or database needed

budgets.token_budget: not enforceable by the harness; recorded as unknown

tasks.description: detect_s3_urls returns false positives and truncated-free captures: any string containing '/s3/' or '.s3.' is returned whole (sentence, not URL), and the s3:// regex captures trailing prose punctuation.
acceptance: all pre-existing pydetactl tests pass unchanged
new regression tests cover both cases

tasks.description: resolve_s3_artifacts prints a fetch-failure warning to stdout. pydetactl writes its machine-readable result to stdout, so one unreachable artifact corrupts piped output.
acceptance: no bytes written to stdout on the fetch-failure path (capsys/capfd observable)
a failed artifact remains non-fatal: other artifacts are still returned
the failure is still reported through the existing logger (core.logger) on stderr
all pre-existing pydetactl tests pass unchanged
new regression test covers stdout cleanliness and non-fatal behaviour

tasks.description: S3 URL classification is duplicated and inconsistent: the resolver decides what is an S3 URL while S3Client._parse_s3_url independently parses it. Extract one shared pure helper and make the resolver return only URLs the client can parse.
acceptance: a single shared pure helper (module-level function) owns s3:// and HTTP(s) S3 URL recognition/parsing; neither file re-implements the scheme logic
S3Client._parse_s3_url keeps its existing contract for every input already covered by the test suite
property: for every URL detect_s3_urls returns against the fixture corpus, S3Client._parse_s3_url resolves a non-empty (bucket, key)
all pre-existing pydetactl tests pass unchanged
new unit tests cover the helper and the resolver/client round-trip property

conditions.A_with_asha: host LLM edits code in its worktree and drives the real Asha MCP server (tools/list, asha_plan_dag or asha_run_spec/review lifecycle, asha_verify_tip, asha_review + submit stages + finalize) from the verified Asha main checkout with an isolated ASHA_STATE_DIR
conditions.B_without_asha: host LLM edits code in its worktree, runs the tests itself, reviews its own diff; no Asha MCP server, tools, CLI, artifacts, journal or Ship Gate

measurement_rules.start: wall clock at first tool call of the execution
measurement_rules.end: wall clock at the moment the agent declares completion
measurement_rules.tokens: not exposed by the delegation harness; recorded as 'Not measured'
measurement_rules.cost: no billing data for delegated subagent runs; recorded as 'Not measured'
measurement_rules.exit_codes: captured verbatim from the final independent validation, which is re-run by the evaluator after the agent stops
measurement_rules.failed_runs: retained verbatim; a rerun is allowed only for an environmental failure defined in this protocol and both runs are kept

exclusion_rules.environmental: the worktree or its virtualenv is unusable (missing interpreter, unreadable repo) and no code was produced
exclusion_rules.not_excluded: failures caused by the submitted code, refusals, gate blocks, timeouts of the agent itself
